result.instructions: Tools for tipee, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who is absent this week, and what kind of absence is it?"; "List all employees with their teams, then show the teams of one of them."; "How many hours did each project get in the last month, split by validation status?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes tipee data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run tipee_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run tipee_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run tipee_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. tipee_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: tipee_list_kinds
tools.title: List resource kinds
tools.description: List the kinds of resources in tipee (at the moment only 'employee'). Call this first to get the kind_id for tipee_list_resources. tipee API: POST /api/directory/kinds.list.

tools.name: tipee_list_resources
tools.title: List resources
tools.description: List the resources (people and integrations) of one kind, with their details. Use with_teams to add team assignments, and filters such as resource.team to limit them. Paginated. tipee API: POST /api/directory/resources.list.

at_date.description: Read the resources as they are on this date.

attributes.description: Attribute ids to return with each resource.

with_total_count.description: Include the total number of matching resources.

filters.description: Filter objects in the shape the tipee reference gives for this operation (each has a "key" and a "value").

next_token.description: next_token from the previous page. Omit it for the first page.

tools.name: tipee_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List teams: the instance, its sites and its sectors. tipee API: POST /api/directory/teams.list.

tools.name: tipee_show_team
tools.title: Show a team
tools.description: Show the details of one team. tipee API: POST /api/directory/teams.show.

tools.name: tipee_show_resource_teams
tools.title: Show a resource's teams
tools.description: Show the team assignments of one resource, optionally for a date range or for head or side roles. tipee API: POST /api/directory/resources.show-teams.

head.description: true for head assignments only, false for side only.

tools.name: tipee_list_absence_types
tools.title: List absence types
tools.description: List the absence types of the instance (for example holidays or sick leave). tipee API: POST /api/schedule/absence-types.list.

requestable.description: Only types that users can request.

tools.name: tipee_list_absences
tools.title: List absences
tools.description: List the absences inside a date range, optionally for some resources. time_range is set when an absence does not cover the whole day. tipee API: POST /api/schedule/absences.list.

tools.name: tipee_list_schedules
tools.title: List schedules
tools.description: List the work schedules inside a date range, optionally for some resources or schedule ids. tipee API: POST /api/schedule/schedules.list.

tools.name: tipee_list_timechecks
tools.title: List timechecks
tools.description: List time clock entries (timechecks) that match the filters. tipee API: POST /api/timeclock/timechecks.list.

filters.description: Filter objects in the shape the tipee reference gives for this operation (each has a "key" and a "value").

tools.name: tipee_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List the projects, with optional filters. tipee API: POST /api/activity/projects.list.

with_task_ids.description: Include the task ids of each project.

filters.description: Filter objects in the shape the tipee reference gives for this operation (each has a "key" and a "value").

tools.name: tipee_show_project
tools.title: Show a project
tools.description: Show one project with its members. tipee API: POST /api/activity/projects.show.

tools.name: tipee_list_project_tasks
tools.title: List project tasks
tools.description: List the tasks of projects that match the filters. tipee API: POST /api/activity/tasks.list.

filters.description: Filter objects in the shape the tipee reference gives for this operation (each has a "key" and a "value").

tools.name: tipee_list_activities
tools.title: List activities
tools.description: List logged activities (time entries on tasks) that match the filters. Each has its task, resource, duration and time range. tipee API: POST /api/activity/activities.list.

filters.description: Filter objects in the shape the tipee reference gives for this operation (each has a "key" and a "value").

tools.name: tipee_show_activity_totals
tools.title: Show activity totals
tools.description: Show the summed durations of activities that match the filters, split by validation status. tipee API: POST /api/activity/activities.show-totals.

filters.description: Filter objects in the shape the tipee reference gives for this operation (each has a "key" and a "value").

tools.name: tipee_list_day_tasks
tools.title: List day tasks
tools.description: List the day tasks (the daily submission of task time) for some resources over a date range. Set is_own to true for the key's own resource only. tipee API: POST /api/activity/day-tasks.list.

is_own.description: true to read only the integration's own day tasks.
